newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH SHARES FALL AHEAD OF U.S. TRADE DATA.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH SHARES FALL AHEAD OF U.S. TRADE DATA.

text.p: Swedish shares were lower at midday Wednesday with trade nervous ahead of U.S. retail trade figures due out at 1230 GMT.
The Stockholm general index fell 1.21 percent to 3,227.32 after shares worth 2.7 billion crowns were traded.
"Right now there are some jitters in the market. When the market opened the bourse fell in line with New York and now it is waiting for the statistics," one broker said.
However some brokers were not expecting too large a fall.
"The liquidity is too strong for the bourse to fall further," one broker said. "Buyers will hold it up."
Losses were mixed across the board with only the forestry sector rising, up 0.08 percent.
SCA posted a better than expected half year profit after financial items of 2.25 billion crowns. It share price fell 1.5 crowns back to 194.5.
"There is a strong trend in SCA but more firms are becoming negative to the share saying it is lagging the business cycle," one broker said.
S-E-Banken raised its trading recommendation on AssiDoman to a 'buy' from 'outperform'. It rose 4.5 crowns to 244.5 crowns.
The banking sector continued to fall, losing 2.71 percent, after S-E-Banken reported a disappointing first half. It was the first of the big four banks to report for the six months.
Market heavyweights lost ground. Telecoms Ericsson fell 5.5 to 358.5 crowns while drugs major Astra lost 5.5 to 136.5 crowns.
